title: Simple Dead Cords
description: This plugin for Paper adds commands for your dead cords! Have 2 langs, Rus and Eng! And it very light! And custom themes.
body:
# ✨ SimpleDeadCords - Death Coordinates Saver ✨

**SimpleDeadCords** is a lightweight, feature-rich plugin that automatically saves your death coordinates and displays them in a beautiful format. Never lose your items again!

## 🌟 Features

### 📍 **Auto-Save Death Coordinates**
- Every time you die, your coordinates are automatically saved
- Includes world name, X, Y, Z coordinates, and death message
- Never forget where you died!

### 🎨 **Customizable Colors**
- Change the plugin color to match your server
- 16 different colors available
- Personal color preference per player
- Command: `/sdccolor <color>`

### 🌍 **Multi-Language Support**
- English (default)
- Russian
- Easy to add more languages
- Command: `/sdclang <en|ru>`

### 📋 **Death History**
- View your last 5 deaths
- Clean, beautiful Unicode formatting
- Shows world, coordinates, and death message
- Commands: `/sdc` or `/dies`

### 🎯 **Additional Features**
- Player-specific settings
- Configurable max deaths history
- Lightweight and optimized
- No performance impact
- Works on Paper 1.21+

## 📸 **Screenshots**
![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a579432d5a0db50bfeec24c9bdb1b9128164041.png)

## 🚀 **Commands**

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/sdc` | Show your recent deaths | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/dies` | Alternative to /sdc | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/sdccolor <color>` | Change plugin color | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/sdclang <en\|ru>` | Change language | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/sdcinfo` | Show plugin information | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/sdc clear` | Clear death history | `simpledeadcords.use` |
| `/sdc help` | Show help menu | `simpledeadcords.use` |

## 🎨 **Available Colors**

- **Primary:** blue, red, green, yellow, purple, aqua
- **Dark variants:** dark_blue, dark_red, dark_green, dark_purple, dark_aqua
- **Others:** gold, white, gray, dark_gray, black

## 📁 **Configuration**

# SimpleDeadCords Configuration

# Default language (en or ru)
default-language: en

# Default plugin color
plugin-color: blue

# Default color for new players
default-player-color: blue

# Maximum number of deaths to save per player
max-deaths-per-player: 5
